scripts.db:dev:product: npx dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/product/schema.prisma
scripts.db:dev:derived: npx dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/derived/schema.prisma
scripts.db:prod:product: npx dotenv -e .env.production -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/product/schema.prisma
scripts.db:prod:derived: npx dotenv -e .env.production -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/derived/schema.prisma
scripts.db:dev: npm run db:dev:product && npm run db:dev:derived
scripts.db:prod: npm run db:prod:product && npm run db:prod:derived
scripts.prisma:generate:dev: npx dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma generate --schema prisma/product/schema.prisma && npx dotenv -e .env.development -- prisma generate --schema prisma/derived/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate:prod: npx dotenv -e .env.production -- prisma generate --schema prisma/product/schema.prisma && npx dotenv -e .env.production -- prisma generate --schema prisma/derived/schema.prisma
